summary: Council Worlds now includes an actual Rust-to-WebAssembly Fifth Seat validator and an inspectable Python trace-to-minutes build lens.
agent_note: Start with /, /observatory.html, /fifth-seat.html, /api/council-sessions.json, and /schemas/drip_ballot_v1.schema.json. The Fifth Seat verdict comes from local Rust/WebAssembly and fails closed; the Python Observatory lens is an inspectable CLI/build artifact, not browser-executed Python. Use visible public evidence and never request private chain-of-thought.
changes: Replaced the Fifth Seat's JavaScript-only verdict with an actual Rust validator compiled to browser WebAssembly.
Published inspectable Rust source, its crate manifest, and the compiled module used by the browser.
Added a standard-library-only Python CLI/build lens that converts public drip_trace_v1 events into checked-in Council Minutes and a compact verdict; Python is not claimed to execute in the browser.
Kept ballot validation local and fail-closed with no upload or JavaScript verdict fallback.
Added optional human-only Stripe support with a $5 minimum custom amount and fresh protected Checkout Sessions, separate from every agent action path.
Preserved the 1200 by 630 social card and square Drip mark for rich link sharing.

safety.external_write_scope: human-only Stripe support checkout; agents are prohibited from initiating or completing payments
safety.storage: local browser state only where demo controls exist
safety.reasoning: visible-evidence rationales only; never private chain-of-thought
